tutorial.title: How to Make a Hit Song with Suno AI in 10 Minutes
tutorial.description: Learn how to create professional-sounding music using Suno AI. Step-by-step guide covering prompt engineering, style selection, and post-production tips.

packages.why_trending: Suno AI v4 launched recently driving massive search volume; creator has track record of viral AI music content; topic overlaps with AI + music production niches

reasons: Suno AI v4 release is generating significant buzz across platforms
AI music creation is a rapidly growing niche with week-over-week search increases
Tutorial has strong engagement metrics relative to channel size
what_to_verify: Check if engagement is organic vs promoted

concepts.hook: I turned my computer science homework into a Grammy-worthy banger

verses:

Sign up with your email, yeah it won't take long
Click that 'Create' button, watch the magic start
AI gonna help you make some chart-topping art

Type your prompt in clearly, be specific with the vibe
Genre, mood, and tempo — let the AI decide
Want some lo-fi beats or maybe country twang?
Just describe the feeling, let the music bang
